Location: Propulsion System Zone: Power Tank. HP: 12,800,000. FTS: 50% resistance to Flinch; Tumble OK; immune to Stun (100%). Attacks: small red fan-shaped AOE (magic) into no-warning rotating fins (MaxHP fractional, absolute Tumble); retreat then 3x straight-line attacks (magic, absolute Ignite) - the 2nd and 3rd lines are very fast; no retreat then 1x straight-line attack (magic, absolute Ignite); spikes (magic, absolute Ignite); meteor (magic, absolute Slow).
Location: Kabla Jabali. HP: 13,500,000. FTS: OK. The blue, player-centered AOE this miniboss releases deals heavy fractional damage.

Location: Stairway to Vital Point. HP: 12,540,000. FTS: OK. Starts emitting shockwaves around itself after moving 10 steps. Location: Boma Konda: Underground Area. HP: 19,100,000. Flinch/Tumble OK; immune to Stun. Attacks: blue AOE, player-centered meteor (fractional, absolute Stun); wide red AOE & frontal triangular breath attack (magic, absolute Ignite) - the safe area is behind the miniboss; star-patterned fins (fractional, absolute Fear); player-centered red AOE attack (physical, absolute Tumble). Tip: use a DPS that can tank a few hits if mass-killing; the Recovery skill is also recommended.

Breath attack (magic) and 2x cross fins (fractional) can inflict absolute Freeze.
